simple.meaning: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God ; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates ; and sometimes as a superlative
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֱלֹהִים (H430) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2600 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֱלֹהִים (ʼĕlôhîym) means gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God ; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates ; and sometimes as a superlative First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 10.
